assessments.comment: Independent inspection-only assessment using the assigned rubric and frozen evidence manifest e3c6253bced7d959cd59873c3d49d166bf5793906bcdf65e49e265076d215499 (cohort remodnav-e3c6253bced7). Source/text metadata and historical execution records inspected; no scientific workflow, container build, payload acquisition or network calls. Binary/annex payloads absent by design, not retrieval failures. Historical exit 0 records are author records, not independent reproduction. Root src/lab-eyetracking original-source submodule is not a consumed analysis input. Current pipeline assessed while noting README retains older instructions. Two criteria remain unanswered; report completion is distinct from native criterion completion.
